purpose: Weight-only (A16) PTQ baselines on Cosmos-Policy-LIBERO-Predict2-2B: GPTQ, GPTVQ, QuIP#, QTIP at W3 and W2, LIBERO-Plus closed loop on panels A+B+C (840 per arm; GPTQ panel A only, 280). Same method ports, Hessian definition and panels as the Fast-WAM A16 baselines; dequantized dense BF16 weights in the official Cosmos get_action runtime.

cosmos.runtime: cosmos_runtime.CosmosRuntime of cosmos-policy-c8-w4a4 (the runtime of the BF16 panel-A run 25838062), arm bf16; quantized arms overwrite the 280 target Linear weights in place
cosmos.target_scope: quantization.select_target_linears: q/k/v/output_proj of self- and cross-attention and mlp.layer1/layer2 in the 28 DiT blocks (1.762 B weights); patch embed, final layer, time embedding, adaLN modulation and other conditioning projections stay BF16, as in every earlier Cosmos experiment

t5.rule: merged = base (the cache the BF16 panel-A run used) + extra (C80 descriptions); keys present in both must be bitwise equal; panel B/C instructions not in it are encoded with CosmosT5TextEncoder(t5-11b, max_length 512) exactly as prepare_text_embeddings.py did, twice, bitwise repeat required

panels.seeds: CosmosRuntime.episode: env seed 800000000 + 1000*index, sampler seed 900000000 + 1000*index + replan (index = slot index 0-839)
panels.invalid_rule: a variant whose task completes during the 30 dummy settling steps is invalid for every arm and is dropped from every comparison

BF16_A.rule: the prep job replays the first policy query of these panel-A episodes (env reset, settling, first get_action); if every first action chunk equals the stored first_action_chunk bitwise, BF16 panel A is reused, otherwise BF16 also runs panel A in the loop job

calibration.hessian: mean x x^T of the BF16 inputs of each target Linear over every denoiser call of the 80 C80 get_action queries (5 NFE each), original coordinates, FP32, no TF32; BF16 model for every method

budget_rule: total stored bits per weight ~= bits; scales, zero points, codebooks, sign vectors and padding counted in bits_total; no fine-tuning; every layer also stores its native codes (GPTQ integer codes, GPTVQ codebooks + indices, QuIP# E8P attr, QTIP trellis + SU/SV/LUT)

single_gpu.time_basis: Fast-WAM A16 quantization of 6.0 B weights took QTIP 1.9, GPTVQ 3.0-3.8, QuIP# 1.3-1.4, GPTQ 0.1 GPU-h; Cosmos has 1.76 B target weights (x0.29), so QTIP ~0.6 h, QuIP# ~0.4 h, GPTVQ ~1.1 h per bit width (split over two jobs); every quant job resumes layer by layer and stops at the soft deadline

loop.name: cabloop
loop.gpu_memory_basis: old BF16 Cosmos episodes peak 6.2 GB reserved per query + ~0.6 GB context, so five workers per A100-40GB
loop.time_basis: 6,160 new episodes (BF16 560, six W2/W3 arms 840, GPTQ 2 x 280); old Cosmos episodes 75-96 s when successful, up to ~230 s at the step cap; ~100 s mean -> ~616k worker-s / 20 slots ~8.6 h, plus GPU sharing and reloads
